metadata.description: Run the pyatlas tests (Python 3.12 in Docker, in-memory Elasticsearch fake, with the Aurelius data of the monorepo)

options.command: docker run --rm -v "$(pwd):/repo:ro" python:3.12-slim sh -c "mkdir -p /w/backend /w/libs/m4i-governance-data-quality/m4i_governance_data_quality/rules && cp -r /repo/backend/pyatlas /w/backend/ && cp -r /repo/backend/m4i-atlas-post-install /w/backend/ && cp -r /repo/libs/m4i-governance-data-quality/m4i_governance_data_quality/rules/definitions /w/libs/m4i-governance-data-quality/m4i_governance_data_quality/rules/ && cd /w/backend/pyatlas && pip install -q --root-user-action=ignore --disable-pip-version-check -e '.[dev]' && python -B -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider"

metadata.description: Run the pyatlas tests with a local Python >= 3.10 (pip install -e '.[dev]' first)
Byte-compile pyatlas (pyatlas has its own Python 3.12 environment, not the workspace Poetry 3.8 one)
Elasticsearch + Kibana + pyatlas with the sample data (docker compose)
Run a parity comparison, e.g. nx run pyatlas:parity --args="store --zip export.zip --pyatlas http://localhost:21000"
